picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest node in DOE's new Genesis Mission, signaling where the federal government is placing its biggest bets on AI-for-science.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: NASA's formal entry into the whole-of-government Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ federal agencies, marks a significant expansion of the executive-order-driven initiative beyond DOE into broader federal science policy.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's mandate to lead six projects and partner on 17 others makes it one of the largest single national-lab commitments in the Genesis Mission rollout, spanning AI, HPC, and quantum research.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the Air Force flying an AI-controlled F-16 is a concrete operational milestone toward autonomous air combat, demonstrating AI moving from research into real-world defense systems.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, underscores the scale of private capital flowing into AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: USC's national lead role developing AI turbulence models with cross-sector applications in energy and transportation shows the Genesis Mission funding translating into concrete scientific research programs.
picks.title: USC leads national AI research project to accelerate scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83 million investment in AI-ready data infrastructure is a major, separate federal commitment reinforcing the research backbone that the broader Genesis Mission initiative depends on.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: The Frank Whittle Summit at Cambridge brought together UK government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven industrial strategy for aerospace, energy, and defence — a notable cross-sector policy and partnership moment for Britain.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's new AGIS program to build generative AI foundation models and agents specifically for scientific research represents a major international bet on AI-native science infrastructure, paralleling the U.S. Genesis Mission.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University's MoU with NVIDIA and launch of the Chula AI Center reflects deepening industry-academia ties driving AI talent and research development in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center
